text.title: 最后一张台上的头戴设备
text.goal: 最后一张台上的头戴设备
text.situation:
最后一张台提供虚拟现实演示。精密头戴设备能展示模拟房间，多功能控制器可用于几个动作。讲解员说新系统处于技术前沿，但仍让乔看安装说明。玛雅拿着同一房间的实体模型，与头戴设备中的视图比较。模型是有形可触的，她能碰到墙。柜台旁的文件夹说明团队如何把游客反馈纳入设计，一些此前建议已纳入修改版。

乔：虚拟房间是实体模型吗？
讲解员：头戴设备中看到的是模拟，玛雅拿着实体模型。
玛雅：会把意见纳入吗？
讲解员：我们会审核，文件夹展示已做的改动。

paragraphs.en: The last counter offered a virtual reality demonstration. A sophisticated headset was capable of presenting a simulated room, while a versatile controller could be used for several actions. The guide called the new system state-of-the-art but still showed Jo the installation notes. Maya held a physical model of the same room and compared it with the view in the headset. The model was tangible: she could touch its walls. A folder beside the counter explained how the team would incorporate visitor feedback. Some earlier suggestions had already been incorporated into the revised design.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is the virtual room a physical model?
Guide: You see a simulation through the headset. Maya has the physical model.
Maya: Will you incorporate the comments?
Guide: We will review them. This folder shows the changes already made.
